## ZGTA V — TrollStore installer

**Build90 test candidate · by zema.**

Install this package in Sileo to download the exact verified IPA and pass it to your existing TrollStore or TrollStore Lite installer. It checks size and SHA-256 before installation.

Requires a compatible TrollStore setup and your own game files. An existing non-TrollStore app with the same identifier is not forcibly overwritten.

### Build90
English-only interface; repaired folder search/rechecks and parent-folder archive access; default unpacking keeps the source archive. Saves, settings, original game/artwork resources and the V+Z icon are retained.

Local native build/package, discovery/extraction and Simulator checks pass. Actual Build90 phone installation, Files-provider access, gameplay, app-data upgrades and reboot behavior are pending. Build88 installation/launcher opening were confirmed separately using the same TrollStore helper interface.

Removing this wrapper leaves the app/data in place. Your own game files and an existing compatible TrollStore setup are required. No AppSync dependency.
